coverage.note: gmLI, WPA and SD-MD cover 2429 of 2430 games walked; REM+ is full-season.

backtest.disclaimer: REM+ predicts next-year run prevention out of sample. Leverage (gmLI, WPA, SD-MD) sits in the Impact columns: the manager assigns it, so it is not skill.

multiyear.note: 3-year REM+ is the Last 3 window's index read from mlbstats_window_l3.json (built 2026-10-22), the same value the Last 3 view prints. The percentile is inside the window's pool; no value ruler is carried onto it. Arms the window does not publish have no value.

war_rate.note: 100 + 10z of eWAR per IP over relievers with 20+ IP: 10 points = 1 pool SD, not the HEM+/REM+/SEM+ ratio scale. eWAR: Baseball-Reference run frame, pitching re-priced on FIP, fielding unchanged pending SDR; position players match bWAR except in seasons they also pitched. No shrink, no clamp; blank under 30 IP.
war_rate.adj_note: war_ip_plus_adj shrinks the rate toward the pool rate by sample size (K = pool median IP = 47.7) and re-standardises on the SHRUNK pool. A readability aid for thin samples, not a forward claim: ship gate G2 failed on every pool, and a post-hoc volume control puts most of the shrink gain down to volume. Does NOT reproduce war/ip on the row.

ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar_v3.json is FanGraphs' published WAR from the frozen vintage plus the site's named departures; it moves only when it is rebuilt by hand.

multiyear_war_rate.note: The 3-year column is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from war_rate_plus_multiyear_eval.json, as of generated_at, not this board's as_of. Arms who joined the pool since have no value.

z_contact_pct.per: swings at pitches in the zone

swstr_pct.per: pitches (whiffs per swing times swings per pitch)

savant_custom.use: display only; no model reads these columns

team_basis.label: pitching 2026
team_basis.note: The club MLB's transaction feed lists today, on the charts and in team totals, so a traded player's whole season counts for his new club. Rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.

team_war.note: team_war is the sum of the club's board rows' pit eWAR, summed UNROUNDED and rounded once; team_war_n is the rows summed, a row whose own eWAR cell is withheld for a zero denominator included. A club with no covered row carries no value. Same club basis as the Team column (see team_basis).

definitions.innings: outs / 3; a line of 6.1 is 19 outs
definitions.par: round(100 x rate / league rate for the role and season), nearest; 100 = average, not inverted, uncoloured
definitions.par_delta: rate minus the league rate, in pitches
definitions.team_par: Team PAR: 100 x the club's rate / the unweighted mean of the club rates on this board, so the clubs average 100
definitions.team_basis: club today: the board rows that name the club, the membership of Offense+, Rotation+ and Bullpen+
